plan.amendment_timing: after training started, before final selection/evaluation/results; not original pre-training preregistration
plan.assumptions: independent representative recording groups and paired method exchangeability under the permutation null; training seeds fixed, not independent sample units
plan.claim_family: fixed sequence on test: unchanged RG-SG recognition gain+No_Gun noninferiority rule first; grounding F1 second
plan.claim_gate: confirmatory grounding claim only if existing test:RG-SG positive_and_noninferior AND grounding positive_evidence
plan.claim_limit: F1 improvement is not a guarantee that every precision/recall/false-box component improved; report all components and harms
plan.endpoint: arithmetic mean over three fixed seeds of pooled box F1 at IoU>=0.50
plan.history: historically used reporting dataset, not newly pristine external validation
plan.insufficient_support: inconclusive if fewer than two positive-GT groups or fewer than95% bootstrap samples retain positive GT; low permutation resolution/wide intervals are not evidence of no effect
plan.interval: 95% paired recording-group percentile interval for F1 difference
plan.multiplicity: nominal alpha0.05 fixed-sequence gatekeeping for these two claims; other splits/endpoints/contrasts exploratory, no additional confirmatory claims
plan.null: joint groupwise exchangeability of RG and SG count vectors, conditional on fixed seeds
plan.positive_evidence: positive RG-SG difference AND two-sided p<=0.05 AND lower95% paired bootstrap interval>0
plan.resampling_unit: recording_group; all associated videos, frames, annotations and three seed pairs stay together
plan.scorer: unchanged report.localization; one-to-one matching; unknown frames excluded; whole-image boxes cannot match; invalid grounding is scored by existing parser
plan.test: two-sided paired recording-group method-label permutation test
